valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027E diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Prolonged U.S. veterinary visit softness and slower diagnostic utilization

base.driver: Mid-teens comparable EPS growth supported by CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue and 50-70 bps margin expansion

bull.driver: Re-accelerating U.S. vet visits, strong international expansion, and operating leverage

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $16.90, the $704.23 close implies 41.67x forward P/E; the Street consensus target (~$718) implies 42.49x forward P/E or $17.10 EPS at 42.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of forward P/E moves the base target by $16.90 (2.4 pp of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: U.S. and international Companion Animal Group (CAG) Diagnostics recurring organic revenue growth and comparable operating margin expansion.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 / Full-Year 2026 earnings release and initial FY2027 guidance (expected early February 2027).

analyst_notes: Following IDEXX's Q3 2026 beat-and-raise on November 2, 2026 (EPS $4.01, FY2026 EPS guidance raised to $14.96-$15.16), named analysts including Erin Wright (Morgan Stanley, $810) and Jonathan Block (Stifel, $700) nudged targets higher, while Chris Schott (JPMorgan, $750) trimmed slightly in October ahead of the print. The +0.8% base-case upside ($709.80 vs. $704.23) is close to Street consensus (~$718, +2.0%), as the stock's ~41.7x FY2027E P/E already prices in steady double-digit recurring diagnostic growth.
